content: Skill `default-model-step-router` updated. This skill file is newly added to unify lock the default model of Hermes CLI/Web UI/Studio/OpenHands CLI/WebUI as step-router-v1, support one-click switching between providers such as stepfun and stepfun-new, and provide functions including automatic trigger, post-execution verification, port memory and periodic self-check, which does not replace Hermes native configuration but only provides batch locking, switching and related auxiliary capabilities. Impact: medium
